scope: Unit tests and disposable PostgreSQL/PostGIS. Auth sessions and Storage simulated; no hosted users/content modified.

results.name: all migrations replay; signup trigger creates an ordinary profile without trusting role metadata
owner profile policies, column grants and avatar paths prevent cross-user access and privilege escalation
preference save is atomic, owner-scoped, normalized and version checked
invalid preferences cannot forge fields, active categories, bounds or booleans
saved places enforce owner, unique identity and published-only insertion
private avatar Storage remains owner-only; ordinary users cannot enter Admin RPCs
redirects, credentials validation, guest storage corruption and legacy preferences are handled safely
callbacks scrub tokens before verification, are idempotent and accept a later distinct callback
callback distinguishes absent PKCE storage, missing details, supported token types and optional flow selector
